sources.localTrivy: Trivy 0.76.2 offline image scan of digest-pinned base images; informational only

baseImage.reason: Node 20 is outside the repository's declared Node 24/26 support range; the Bookworm layer carried all five baseline critical image advisories.

localTrivyScan.note: Informational local scan only. Hosted Trivy SARIF from the pinned CI action is the authoritative gate evidence; a local Docker build is still unavailable.

localRateLimitVerification.result: Requests 1-3 returned 200 with RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset; requests 4-5 returned 429 rate_limited with Retry-After. The default 1000/900000 configuration is unchanged.

codeChanges.change: Moved to the supported digest-pinned Node 24 Trixie base and added a container HEALTHCHECK for the API health route.
Startup logs now emit fixed prototype/simulated mode labels instead of environment-derived values.
Windows cmd.exe quoting now escapes backslashes before quotes.
Static prototype serving now verifies realpath containment in addition to lexical containment.
Replaced the custom fixed-window middleware with the CodeQL-recognised express-rate-limit package, installed before all prototype routes including the SPA fallback.
Added the MIT-licensed express-rate-limit package as the recognised prototype baseline limiter.

dispositions.rationale: app.ts now uses the CodeQL-recognised express-rate-limit package before all routes, including the SPA fallback. The prototype cap, IETF headers and 429 rate_limited contract are preserved; distributed rate limiting remains an explicit production gap.
dispositions.followUp: Confirm closure on the next hosted CodeQL analysis, then implement and evidence a distributed limiter before any pilot or production promotion.

dispositions.rationale: Startup logs were changed to fixed labels. Remaining hits are diagnostic error/pass arrays in local CLI tooling; the deterministic secret scan blocks credentials in source and logs.
dispositions.followUp: Adopt structured log redaction and external audit sinks before pilot.

dispositions.rationale: The static prototype server normalises the URL path, confines it to apps/prototype and now verifies realpath containment before streaming files.
dispositions.followUp: Replace the dependency-free static server with a production-reviewed asset pipeline before pilot.

dispositions.rationale: Both render() sinks are fed by deterministic view builders that escape dynamic values with esc(); the prototype has no live user-generated production surface.
dispositions.followUp: Introduce a reviewed templating or sanitisation library before any user-generated content is accepted.

dispositions.rationale: cmd.exe argument quoting now escapes backslashes before quotes, addressing the CodeQL finding in scripts/with-env.mjs.
dispositions.followUp: Confirm closure on the next hosted CodeQL analysis.

priorRescan.note: Historical rescan after the base-image and prototype hardening work. The five critical image advisories and the single IaC finding were closed.

hostedVerification.note: Hosted code scanning was rescanned after commit a0bac80. All 22 js/missing-rate-limiting alerts are closed; 33 triaged open alerts remain with documented owners and follow-up work. This is not launch or production security evidence.

blockingRules: No critical advisory is excepted; the five baseline critical image findings must be removed by the base-image upgrade, not waived.
Trivy SARIF uploads remain blocking workflow steps; CodeQL and Trivy findings remain advisory until triaged and evidenced.
Hosted alert closure requires a post-remediation rescan recorded in remediation.hostedVerification.
Green Phase 1 CI proves gate parity only and does not supply production security, compliance or launch evidence.
promotionAllowed remains false and the verdict remains NO-GO.
evidenceGaps: Local container build and startup remain unverified; the base image was scanned by digest only.
No distributed rate limiter, production asset pipeline, structured log redaction or centralised audit sink is attached.
No signed release, penetration test or production security evidence is attached by this triage.
